thread:
alex: Heads-up — release blocked: final artifact verify failed during multipart upload to registry, deploy-bot aborted promote.

ci-bot: [automated] verify-step failed: checksum mismatch (expected=sha256:77aa33bb got=sha256:77aa00ff). Job 8120: https://ci.internal/8120/logs

maria: Which candidate was that and do we have a last-known-good?

alex: It was redwood/auth@2026-05-12-rc3. Last-known-good is redwood/auth@2026-05-10-rc8.

ops-oncall: I'm seeing STALE connections and 502s from the upload proxy around 04:22UTC. Rolling a quick restart of the proxy worker and clearing stale multipart temp files.

maria: Change window in 25m; recommend manual pin to rc8 so we don't delay the DB migration. We can re-promote rc3 after post-release validation.

alex: Agreed. I'll pin and annotate release notes. /promote redwood/auth@2026-05-10-rc8 --reason "manual pin: rc3 artifact truncated during multipart upload"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete — redwood/auth@2026-05-10-rc8 promoted to candidate. Release notes: "Pinned to last-known-good after artifact verification failure on newer candidate."

ci-bot: job 8120 (rerun) started on runner-11.

ci-bot: job 8120 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS. Artifact verified on rerun.

alex: Rerun succeeded but pin was correct for the change window. Filing ISSUE-1201 to triage intermittent upload truncation and add client preflight checksum + retry. Assigning to infra and release-eng.

ops-oncall: I'll keep monitoring proxy metrics and capture pcap if it recurs.

maria: Thanks team, action items noted. Will update release notes and notify stakeholders. :thumbsup:
